exposure: Antenatal mental health (depressive disorder, anxiety symptoms)
cohort: The study included 236 pregnant women (52 with depressive disorder and 184 controls) and their infant offspring.
finding: The study found that placental 11b-HSD2 mRNA expression mediates the relationship between maternal antenatal depression and anxiety and infant cortisol reactivity, with the direction of reactivity differing based on maternal antidepressant use.
